promptBlocks._note: 原文取自 SwarmDuel/art/prompts 與 tools/anim_prompts.py；{大括號} 為佔位符。
promptBlocks.header: Generate one image with your image generation tool. Do not write any files.
promptBlocks.styleLock: Style lock (shared by every asset in this game): original 16-bit pixel art for a top-down 3/4 overhead action game, chunky clean pixel clusters, 1-pixel dark contour, limited palette with 3 tones per material (shadow / mid / highlight), light from the upper-left, bold saturated Saturday-morning-cartoon colors aimed at a North American audience. Original design only: no Pokemon, no existing franchise characters. Actual transparent background (alpha), NOT a painted checkerboard. No text, no labels, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no gradients, no smooth airbrush shading, no blur.
promptBlocks.identitySheet:
Generate one image with your image generation tool. Do not write any files.

Create a character identity reference sheet for an original {ROLE: game hero | swarm enemy}: "{NAME}", {CHARACTER_DESC}.
Show exactly three full-body poses of the SAME character side by side, same scale, evenly spaced{, standing idle}: (1) facing the camera / down, (2) facing right, (3) facing away / up.
Target native game frame after processing: about {W}x{H} pixels per pose with feet at bottom-center{, so draw with big readable pixel blocks}.
Style lock (shared by every asset in this game): original 16-bit pixel art for a top-down 3/4 overhead action game, chunky clean pixel clusters, 1-pixel dark contour, limited palette with 3 tones per material (shadow / mid / highlight), light from the upper-left, bold saturated Saturday-morning-cartoon colors aimed at a North American audience. Original design only: no Pokemon, no existing franchise characters. Actual transparent background (alpha), NOT a painted checkerboard. No text, no labels, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no gradients, no smooth airbrush shading, no blur.
promptBlocks.nativeLowResTail: Draw it as TRUE LOW-RESOLUTION pixel art: each pose is exactly 32x40 art pixels, and the whole image is upscaled with nearest-neighbour so every art pixel is a clean, equal, hard-edged square block (about 16x16 screen pixels per art pixel). No sub-pixel detail, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no smooth curves. 1-art-pixel dark outline around the whole silhouette. Limited palette (max 16 colors). Light from upper-left. Actual transparent background (alpha). No text, labels, ground, or shadow.
promptBlocks.nativeSheet:
Generate one image with your image generation tool. Do not write any files.

Create a sprite reference sheet for an original {ROLE: top-down 3/4 action game hero | swarm enemy}: "{NAME}", {CHARACTER_DESC}. Show exactly three {standing idle }poses side by side with wide transparent gaps: (1) facing the camera, (2) facing right, (3) facing away.
Draw it as TRUE LOW-RESOLUTION pixel art: each pose is exactly {W}x{H} art pixels, and the whole image is upscaled with nearest-neighbour so every art pixel is a clean, equal, hard-edged square block (about 16x16 screen pixels per art pixel). No sub-pixel detail, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no smooth curves. 1-art-pixel dark outline around the whole silhouette. Limited palette (max 16 colors). Light from upper-left. Actual transparent background (alpha). No text, labels, ground, or shadow.

beats: frame 1: relaxed standing pose, arms down
frame 2: the same standing pose breathing in: head and shoulders exactly 1 art pixel lower, arms 1 art pixel further from the body; feet do not move
frame 1: contact pose, left foot forward and right foot back, arms swinging opposite to the legs
frame 2: passing pose, legs together under the body, body 1 art pixel higher
frame 3: contact pose, right foot forward and left foot back (mirror of the frame 1 leg/arm positions)
frame 4: passing pose, legs together under the body, body 1 art pixel higher

facing.down: facing the camera (front view, viewer sees the face)
facing.down_right: three-quarter FRONT view turned toward the viewer's right (face visible, body angled 45 degrees to the right, toward the bottom-right of the screen)
facing.right: side profile facing the viewer's right
facing.up_right: three-quarter BACK view: the character walks away toward the top-right of the screen, body rotated 45 degrees, so we see its back AND its right side (right arm and right shoulder fully visible, left arm mostly hidden behind the body, face hidden). Every frame keeps exactly this rotation and size
facing.up: facing away from the camera (back view, face not visible)
